company_info.company_description: "Green Energy Technologies (GET) are the local experts in affordable energy servicing the Brisbane, Mackay, Whitsundays, and Townsville regions.Our extensive network of clients are continuously amazed by the value we offer through products and ongoing service and support. GET is a local company staffed by locals and working for locals. We are always nearby to make sure you are getting the most out of your solar investment, and we’re just a friendly phone call away if you have any queries or concerns about your system!We are committed to providing you with exceptional, personalised service throughout the entire process, from the initial sale to post-install servicing years down the road. We understand that designing the perfect solar system for your needs is an important decision, and we are here to guide you through the process and answer your questions honestly.Our pricing is 100% transparent so you will never be charged for any hidden extras such as travel or connection to the grid. We are proud to install some of the highest quality and most efficient equipment available. Our tech has features including broad spectrum light technology for increased electricity production on overcast days, high clarity anti-reflective solar glass and salt mist corrosion protection for our coastal locations.Our team of fully qualified, in-house electricians are able to assist with not only your solar requirements, but also additional electrical works such as switchboard upgrades, bringing energy tariffs across for best usage and generator cut over switches, which are all offered as part of our personalized service.If you are looking for superior products and workmanship, great local service and ongoing support with your solar energy investment, call the friendly team at Green Energy Technologies today!"

I’m very very happy with green energy. Have already recommended to other people. Nothing was too much trouble on installation.  Neat and tidy. Top job ?

Quoting process was easy and the team were very helpful.Install occurred over two days, I had opted for a catch relay. Unfortunately, my installer had not installed one of these before and was unaware of the monitoring monocle and told me it only controlled the hot water or other designated loads. I told him it did and actually did the job of an inverter monitoring device. He did not believe me and consequently I have paid for the proprietary monitor with the sun grow inverter as well. I still am only using the icloud app, which is fine. I am a bit disappointed that the installer didn’t understand the product he was installing especially when this info is readily available on the net.I received the starter pack which was helpful.System been in for two weeks, works great.Overall good experience, let down by unfamiliarity of component supplied.
Superior warranty , expertise shown and continued support for longer extended time

The salesman was knowledgeable and answered all our questions. I was after quality components and felt I got exactly what I wanted. Yesterday's installation was quick and there were no problems. The installer spent a good time explaining all aspects of the installation and what to expect in the coming weeks and years. Overall we are very happy and look forward to seeing the financial benefits over the coming years.
Ryan was on the all with the quote and Jacob and the team were great with the install.

Fantastic and neat install, good customer service, communication can be hit and miss depending on who you get, but overall is very good.The major letdown is the sales reps not really knowing what they are talking about, we had quite the saga getting an "off-grid" capable battery system, we have constant power outages where we are, so we wanted something capable of whole house backup, which was known by the original sales rep but they sold us a solar system that was not really compatible with the direction we wanted to go, but that's my bad for not doing my own comprehensive research.After the 3rd sales rep gave up on us, they flicked us over to one of their experienced installers for us to explain what we our requirements in a battery system was.The installer listened to what our expectations from a battery was and managed to get a quote back to us with a detailed description of how it was all going to work within a few days.We finally got a battery system that was exactly what we wanted, just needed to talk to the right person with the right knowledge and experience. (This is the difference between someone that sells the system to someone that actually has experience with it)We got a Selectronic 7.5 Kw inverter with 20kWh of PowerPlus Eco Batteries which gives us whole house backup, not just an off the shelf Powerwall that was not going to meet our needs and to boot we can add extra batteries if we need to in the future.After running they system for about 5 months we put another 2 batteries in to give us 28kWh which sees us through a hot summer night now, we ended up buying them from a different company as the price quoted by Green Energy Technologies was over double the cost from elsewhere, which I found disappointing as we had already spent around 45k with them up until this point.Overall, I would give installation & installers a 10/10, customer service & after sales support a 9/10 and sales reps a 2/10.Would I buy another system from them, more than likely I would, as a quality installation and knowledgeable installers trumps a sales team that only knows what they read in the brochure in my opinion.

Easy to understand and informative quoting process.Installation went ahead earlier than initially planned, which was exactly what I had asked for if the possibility arose.The guys who did the install were professional, very polite and the end job was 5 star.Customer service before, during and now after installation has been 2nd to none, I couldn't be happier and only regret not seeking out solar sooner.

Each of the installers that quoted were really good, being clear and informative and all prices quoted were pretty much similar. The only reason we went with Green Energy Technologies was because they elected to put our system on the carport roof with strengthened rails. The other 2 installers quoted for the system to go on the home's decramastic roof. With decramastic rooves being lightweight, and prone to cracks and dents we were concerned if there was a leak, that it would be a costly exercise to repair.GET installers and sales person were punctual, friendly and very knowledgeable allowing for an enjoyable experience.
Green Energy Tech was great to work with. Punctual, professional and friendly. The system is working very well

Excellent service in every way. The fact that they came to my home to check it over and explained brilliantly why they recommended what they did. It has now been a month since installation and my small power bill backs up their claims. Lots of free after installation support also offered.
